1.

The following prayer has been made in the instant petition:
"A. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the state respondents to not to demolish the boundary wall and not to dispossess the petitioner from Arazi No.483 situating at Shaha Urf Pipal Gaon, Tehsil- Sadar,
District- Prayagraj measuring area 293.23 sq. mtr. out of 8900 sq. mtr. without any award of compensation and making the payment of the same in accordance with the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013."

sentences.text: The case of the petitioner is that the respondents intend to take forcible possession of the aforesaid land of the petitioner without any formal acquisition or payment of compensation.

3. The grievance of the petitioner is that a notification under Section 19 of the Act has been issued on 5th of November, 2024 but the respondents have notified that possession would be taken within seven days, although, award has not been made so far.
It is submitted that the respondent cannot take possession without making the award.

4. Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents submits that since notification under Section 19 of the Act has already been issued, it will be followed by an award and taking over of possession strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Act.

5. Having regard to the said statement, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the respondent shall determine and pay compensation to the petitioner and take possession of the acquired land strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed.

(Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 9.12.2024 Ankit.
